import datetime,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);launch=json.loads((out/'launch.json').read_text());start=time.time()
def status(state,**extra):
 data=dict(state=state,pid=os.getpid(),updated_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),elapsed_seconds=time.time()-start,**extra)
 temp=out/'status.tmp';temp.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');temp.replace(out/'status.json')
status('starting')
try:
 child=subprocess.Popen(launch['command'],cwd=launch['cwd'])
 while child.poll() is None:
  status('running',trainer_pid=child.pid)
  time.sleep(30)
 if child.returncode:
  status('failed',returncode=child.returncode);sys.exit(child.returncode)
 summary=subprocess.run([launch['command'][0],'summarize_transfer.py',str(out/'results.json'),'--output',str(out/'summary.json')],cwd=launch['cwd'])
 status('complete' if summary.returncode==0 else 'summary_failed',returncode=summary.returncode)
except BaseException as error:
 status('failed',error=repr(error));raise
